title: One Thursday, from dry to storm
subtitle: Times and figures reported by KXAN, CBS Austin and Austin Energy
alt: Timeline of Thursday, Aug. 27, 2026 in Central Texas: overnight the West Travis County Public Utility Agency records 5.27 million gallons used in irrigation-sized bursts between 7 p.m. Wednesday and 6 a.m. Thursday; Thursday morning three Lake Travis ISD campuses lose water pressure and students are given bottled water; shortly before 1:30 p.m. the district says pressure is restored at all three schools; at 4:24 p.m. crews are called to a house under construction that collapsed on workers in south Austin, killing one; Thursday evening about 7,000 Austin Energy customers lose power as storms move through; and by 9:10 p.m. 41 outages still affect 1,085 customers
source: KXAN, CBS Austin and Austin Energy
